theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+1.28%) and Industrials (+1.04%) led the market today, while Materials (-2.03%) and Consumer Staples (-1.80%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.49% versus -0.66% for defensives and -0.50% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.02% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -0.25%. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.83%. The VIX fell 3.31% to 20.47, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.16% to $3,939.00, crude oil was little changed at $95.85, and bitcoin gained 1.05% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
